abilities.name: Cram Session
abilities.description: Study one subject for a night and you can recall it perfectly through the next day's exam.
abilities.cost: No sleep; you forget most of it by the week's end

growth.grows: how hard a subject and how long you keep it

abilities.name: Spell Echo Notes
abilities.description: Write a spell's words in your notes as you hear them and you can cast it once at half strength.
abilities.cost: The notebook page burns when the spell is cast

growth.grows: how strong the copy and how many pages

abilities.name: Teacher's Pet
abilities.description: Answer a professor's question well and you can ask one favor of them that week.

abilities.name: Dormitory Rumor Mill
abilities.description: Ask around the dormitory and by evening you can hear what every student is saying about one person.
abilities.cost: Someone tells that person you were asking

growth.grows: how secret the talk you hear

abilities.name: Familiar Bond
abilities.description: Call a small animal familiar and see through its eyes for a few minutes.
abilities.cost: You feel its fear and hunger as your own

growth.grows: how long and how far it can roam

abilities.name: Duel Etiquette
abilities.description: When you challenge someone to a formal duel, they must accept or lose standing, and the rules hold both of you.
abilities.cost: Losing the duel costs you standing

growth.grows: how senior a student must accept

abilities.name: Library Pathfinder
abilities.description: Walk into any library and you can find the shelf with the book you need within a few minutes.
abilities.cost: The restricted section still needs a pass

abilities.name: Practice Shield
abilities.description: Cast a thin shield that stops one weak spell or thrown object, then shatters.
abilities.cost: Drains your focus for the next lesson

growth.grows: how strong a spell it stops

abilities.name: Curfew Slip
abilities.description: Move through the halls after curfew and the night prefect never quite catches you, until dawn.
abilities.cost: Get caught once and you are watched for a week

growth.grows: how strict a guard you slip past

abilities.name: Group Project
abilities.description: Work with classmates on a task and you can combine your skills so the result is better than any of you alone.
abilities.cost: One of them will take the credit

growth.grows: how many people and how much better

abilities.name: Potion Lab Intuition
abilities.description: Brew a potion from a half-remembered recipe and you can sense when an ingredient is wrong before it explodes.
abilities.cost: Singed eyebrows if you ignore the feeling

abilities.name: Rival's Measure
abilities.description: Watch a rival fight once and you can name their strongest move and their worst habit.
abilities.cost: They are watching you just as closely

growth.grows: how much of their style you read
